contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (36370.74) on the p7 Summary Page — the PROMOTED per-period cell — which is also the filer's own DONATIONS ledger's printed 'Total 36370.74' at the foot of p5 (the ledger's only printed total, covering its three sheets p3+p4+p5).
contributions.detail: The 100 MONETARY rows of the filer's own DONATIONS ledger sum to 9,501.00 (p3, 35 rows) + 8,237.77 (p4, 39 rows) + 18,631.97 (p5, 26 rows) = 36,370.74 exactly, which is the ledger's printed Total and the cover's promoted per-period Box B to the cent. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 51,669.05 and is retained as the CUMULATIVE figure, never summed as an increment. THE PUBLISHED ROW SET ALSO CARRIES ONE IN-KIND ROW (United Alliance 7,500.00, from the separate p6 sheet headed 'INKIND'), so the gross sum of all 101 published rows is 43,870.74 — that is the figure checkrec.py reports — while the CASH-ONLY figure of 36,370.74 is what the document's three printed statements state. The Ellingson-2018 precedent in this module is followed exactly: the in-kind row is published with in_kind=true and excluded from the anchor. The 5,000.00 'Jeff Gray LOAN' row IS an itemized contribution row here, decided by the ladder (§B3): it lies inside the printed 36,370.74 and the cover has no beginning-balance slot to absorb it.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (37900.38) on the p7 Summary Page — the PROMOTED per-period cell — which is also the filer's own EXPENDITURES ledger's printed 'Total 37900.38' at the foot of p2.
expenditures.detail: The 20 rows of the filer's own EXPENDITURES ledger sum to 273.30 + 305.20 + 550.45 + 50.00 + 100.00 + 25.00 + 68.56 + 2879.73 + 577.37 + 63.17 + 23.04 + 160.00 + 3853.27 + 14.40 + 2639.45 + 2932.86 + 744.96 + 850.94 + 12788.68 + 9000.00 = 37,900.38 exactly = the ledger's printed Total = Box D. Box E 'Expenditures Made Year to Date' prints 49,212.73 and is retained as cumulative, never summed. The printed 'Total' line is NOT a 21st row — it is separated from row 20 by three empty line positions, it is labelled 'Total' in the Who column, and it equals the sum of the rows above it (§H4). The one-band-past control below row 20 rendered an empty strip.

in_kind_convention: MONETARY-ONLY (CASH-ONLY), and it was tested on BOTH sides of THIS filing per §G1 rather than inherited — which matters here because the SAME FILER's other document in this chunk (key 2904e2a5, his 30-days-after-General report) is a cover-only PDF on which no convention can be tested at all, so nothing was carried between them. Contributions: the 100 cash rows sum to 36,370.74 = the ledger's printed Total = Box B; adding the p6 INKIND sheet's 7,500.00 gives 43,870.74, which matches NO printed figure anywhere in the document. So this filer keeps in-kind on a physically separate sheet AND outside his stated contributions total — the summit 'McKenna separate' pattern. Expenditures: no row is marked in-kind and there is no in-kind column, so the two conventions coincide at 37,900.38 and both close.
escalation_note: Six escalations at 500-900 dpi, none of which changed a value. (1)-(5) The five per-page row-band proofs listed in each frame's measure_note (first row, last row, and the mandatory one-band-past control on every ledger page). ONE OF THESE CAUGHT A REAL OFF-BY-ONE BEFORE IT SHIPPED: the first p4 band list was seeded from rowbands.py's first detected text band (11.11) and its row-1 crop rendered '100' — Shauna Chambers, the SECOND entry — proving the detector had missed the narrow '50' of the first entry; the origin was moved one pitch up to 8.67 and the re-crop rendered '50'. (6) All six Summary-Page boxes were cropped individually at 500 dpi (c3d66073_p7_A/BC/DE/F/close.png) to settle the cover ladder described in `notes`; every box reproduced exactly as first read (A 3517.55, B 36370.74, C 51669.05, D 37900.38, E 49212.73, F 39888.28, close 2456.32) and nothing was adjusted.

2.measure_note: THIS PAGE IS THE FILER'S OWN TYPED LEDGER, NOT A COUNTY FORM: it prints NO rules of any kind and rowbands.py returns rules=0 / bands=0 at full width. The §A2 recovery was used — `rowbands.py <pdf> 2 --text-lines --col 45,60` returns 21 text bands, of which the ledger rows run from y=16.15 to y=54.88 at a constant pitch, with two narrow amounts ('50' at row 4 and '25' at row 6) not detected. Fitting first-to-last gives pitch = (54.88 - 16.15)/19 = 2.0384 and the band tops are set 0.40 above each text top, so row i spans [15.75 + (i-1)*2.0384, +2.04]. The two column bands are HAND-MEASURED off the 200 dpi page (Who about 12-45 pct, Amount about 46-60 pct) because no rule exists to detect; the Amount band is deliberately wider than the ink so the widest figure (12788.68) cannot clip (§G2). PROOF at 900 dpi --value: the row-1 box pct:46.0,15.75,14.0,2.04@p2 rendered '273.3' (recorded 273.3); the row-20 box pct:46.0,54.48,14.0,2.04@p2 rendered '9000' (recorded 9000); and the CONTROL one band past the last row, pct:46.0,56.52,14.0,2.04@p2, rendered a completely EMPTY strip — no figure below the last row, so §F1 trap 5 is ruled out and the printed 'Total' further down is not an entry.

3.measure_note: Filer's own typed DONATIONS ledger, sheet 1 of 3; rowbands.py returns rules=0 at full width. §A2 recovery: `--text-lines --col 45,60` returns 33 bands, the ledger rows running y=15.66 (row 1) to y=84.98 (row 35) with four narrow amounts (rows 28, 30, 32, 33 — all '50' or '25') undetected. Pitch fitted first-to-last = (84.98 - 15.66)/34 = 2.0388, and it reproduces every detected band to within 0.2 pct (e.g. row 29 predicted 72.75, detected 72.75). Band tops set 0.40 above the text top. Columns hand-measured as on p2. PROOF at 900 dpi --value: the row-1 box pct:46.0,15.26,14.0,2.04@p3 rendered '250' (recorded 250); the row-35 box pct:46.0,84.58,14.0,2.04@p3 rendered '100' (recorded 100); the CONTROL one band past, pct:46.0,86.62,14.0,2.04@p3, rendered EMPTY. This sheet prints no subtotal of its own — the ledger's single printed Total is on p5.

4.measure_note: Filer's own typed DONATIONS ledger, sheet 2 of 3; no printed rules, no repeated column headings (the sheet begins straight in on its first name). §A2 recovery: `--text-lines --col 45,60` returns 30 bands from y=11.11 to y=86.53. ⚠ THE DETECTOR'S FIRST BAND IS NOT ROW 1: the first entry's amount is a narrow '50' that the scan misses, and the row-1 proof crop taken from y=10.71 rendered '100' — Shauna Chambers, the second entry — which is what caught the off-by-one. The origin was moved one pitch up. Pitch = (86.53 - 11.11)/37 = 2.0384 with 11.11 = row 2, so row i spans [8.67 + (i-1)*2.0384, +2.04]. RE-PROOF at 900 dpi --value: the corrected row-1 box pct:46.0,8.67,14.0,2.04@p4 rendered '50' (recorded 50 for Jill hernandez); the row-39 box pct:46.0,86.12,14.0,2.04@p4 rendered '26.25' (recorded 26.25 for Candid Ward); and the CONTROL one band past, pct:46.0,88.16,14.0,2.04@p4, rendered EMPTY. Columns hand-measured as on p2. This sheet prints no subtotal of its own.

5.measure_note: Filer's own typed DONATIONS ledger, sheet 3 of 3, carrying the ledger's only printed Total. No rules. §A2 recovery: `--text-lines --col 45,60` returns 22 bands from y=8.67 (row 1) to y=59.61 (row 26), plus the Total line far below at y=67.71. Pitch = (59.61 - 8.67)/25 = 2.0376; band tops 0.40 above the text top. PROOF at 900 dpi --value: the row-1 box pct:46.0,8.27,14.0,2.04@p5 rendered '103.48' (recorded 103.48 for Jeff Johnson); the row-26 box pct:46.0,59.21,14.0,2.04@p5 rendered '1000' (recorded 1000 for Josh Holyoak); the CONTROL one band past, pct:46.0,61.25,14.0,2.04@p5, rendered EMPTY. A wider 400 dpi tail strip (pct:10.0,58.0,60.0,12.0@p5) additionally shows rows 25 and 26 followed by blank space and then the labelled 'Total 36370.74', confirming the Total is not a 27th entry and that nothing is hidden between the last row and it.

6.measure_note: The filer's own separate one-line sheet headed 'INKIND' with its own 'Name / Amount' headings; no rules, and `--text-lines --col 45,60` returns only three bands (the Amount heading, its underline, and the single data line at y=16.18). With one row on the page, EVERY row is proved: the row-1 box pct:46.0,15.78,14.0,2.04@p6 rendered '7500' at 900 dpi --value (recorded 7500), and the CONTROL one band past, pct:46.0,17.82,14.0,2.04@p6, rendered EMPTY — the sheet carries exactly one entry and no total of its own. Columns hand-measured as on the other ledger sheets.
